message.content:
A classic lasagna typically includes:

| Category | Typical Ingredients |
|----------|---------------------|
| **Noodles** | Lasagna sheets (no-boil or regular) |
| **Cheeses** | Ricotta (or cottage cheese), shredded mozzarella, grated Parmesan |
| **Meat** | Ground beef, Italian sausage, or a mix; optional pork or veal |
| **Sauce** | Marinara or Bolognese (tomato‑based with onions, garlic, herbs); sometimes béchamel (white sauce) |
| **Vegetables** | Finely chopped onion, minced garlic, diced carrots, celery, spinach, mushrooms, zucchini, bell peppers |
| **Seasonings & Extras** | Olive oil, dried basil, oregano, thyme, red pepper flakes, salt, black pepper, bay leaf, parsley, egg (for binding ricotta mixture) |
| **Optional Additions** | Eggplant slices, olives, capers, fresh basil leaves, crushed tomatoes, pancetta, prosciutto |

These ingredients can be mixed and matched depending on whether you prefer a meat‑based, vegetarian, or even vegan lasagna.
